decisive_items: Transvaginal ultrasound demonstrated an 18 cm diameter ovarian tumor
a large, fluid-filled lesion measuring 19.3 × 6.2 × 21 cm, located in the pelvis and mid-abdomen, displacing the uterus and compressing the aorta and inferior vena cava
The lesion appeared unilocular with a 1.5 mm wall and no septations or solid components, and was suggestive of an ovarian origin
response.rationale: The imaging features of a large, unilocular, thin-walled, fluid-filled ovarian lesion without solid components best support a benign ovarian cystadenoma. Mucinous cystadenoma is a plausible subtype but is not specifically supported because the lesion lacks septations or other mucinous features. Ovarian fibroma is inconsistent with a purely fluid-filled cystic lesion.

rejected.why: Ovarian fibroma is a solid tumor, contradicted by the unilocular fluid-filled lesion with no solid components.
